method.source: Git object reads at the fixed baseline; line numbers are one-based.
method.runtime: No tests, builds, product helpers, UI, HTTP, sockets, or processes were used.
method.workingTree: The listed baseline blobs are immutable Git-object content; unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes were left untouched.

sourceEvidence.supports: Windows host explicitly registers NativeShell UI, Crystal minimap, HUD, chat, notice, quest UI, and optional screenshot capture. It also provides the keyboard host, GameShop preview geometry, shell/gateway/gameplay inboxes, and BigMap state/queue.
Native login/character-selection shell UI plugin and its keyboard/pointer/update systems.
HUD plugin registers the overlay plugin, which owns inventory, character, skills, social, shop, mail, storage, ranking, guild, and companion panels.
Crystal chat presentation and chat actions are registered by Windows.
Crystal minimap plugin.
Quest/NPC/target/drop intent presentation and handling.
Shared typed shell, HUD, options, inventory/storage, mail, quest, chat, combat/world and lifecycle actions.
Auditable source inventory of native visible controls, including screen/panel/action/condition/instance scope and intentional visual-only or no-op status.
Ranking/PlayerInspect module inclusion, native typed player UI intents, UI state, registry-backed control enums, plugin wiring and visible GameShop/skillbar/guild/rank dispatches.

Complete NativeOutboundCommand enum and serialized command discriminants, covering auth/session, world/combat, quests/map, bag/equipment/storage/shop/mail, social/friends/ranking, guild, companion/hero, skills/modes and trade.
Guild storage commands and conversion of Native UI intents to exact outbound command variants; ranking, friend, guild rank/notice/buff and trade mappings are explicit.
Separates local lifecycle from wire commands and classifies all Native wire actions as procedure/world/personal/leave scopes.
Native movement and keyboard/pointer world input; death revive, spell cast, combat modes, pet mode, spell toggle and skill sends.
Hero switching/behaviour/autopot, hero inventory transfer, take-back, use, move, equip/remove and merge.
Equipment-slot changes, fishing cast/autocast and intelligent-creature pickup/update/control commands.
Marriage/divorce/mentor mutations and replies, plus inbound bond request/update packets.
Native Ranking UI supports rank class, online-only filter, paging, refresh and ranking-row inspect; inspect sends an Inspect request with ranking=true and hero=false.
Friend refresh, remove by character index and memo update by character index.
Incoming group invitation accept/decline and group membership controls.
Guild invite, recruit, rank assignment/name/eight permission toggles, notice and guild-buff actions.
Native player and hero skill-bar presentation/action definitions; overlays and input map casts to Magic and key assignment to MagicKey.

existing11Families.status: The goal's F01-F11 are usable as high-level domains, not a complete frozen action denominator.
confirmedRequiredSubfamilies: F06: spellbar click/refresh, Magic/MagicKey/SpellToggle, keyboard attack/pet modes; registered Native behaviors.
F09: distinguish ordinary NPC buy/sell/repair from Cash GameShop catalog/purchase/receipt.

F11: include Friends memo/remove/refresh; Ranking refresh/class/onlineOnly/paging/row inspect; group and guild incoming replies; guild recruit/rank assignment/rank name/permission bits/buff; marriage/divorce/mentor incoming replies; trade item/gold/confirmation.
F02: include Big Map search/marker selection/eligible NPC teleport and ordinary world movement/combat/quest interactions.
existing11Families.not_new_top_level_families: These are source-evidenced action groups within F01-F11, not a reason to fabricate a new family count.

notRegisteredAtBaseline.finding: No auction/market UI control family or corresponding auction/market NativeOutboundCommand variant appears in the complete baseline UI registry and protocol enum inspected.
No territory/castle-war UI control family or corresponding NativeOutboundCommand variant appears in the inspected baseline registry and protocol enum.

coverageFindings.boundedNativeInspect: PlayerInspectUi is included in RankingDialogUi and the visible RankingAction::Inspect row path sends Inspect { ranking: true, hero: false }. This proves ranking-row inspection only. A separate ordinary world-object/hero inspect trigger was not established from the native control/action registry; keep that scope unknown.
commonOrServerUnknown: UI registration and Native wire construction prove an attempted action, not successful server support, authoritative ACK, or end-to-end behavior.
Guild rank controls and EditGuildMember wire are Native-registered, but server-side rank assignment/create/permission semantics and ACK behavior require their own backend proof.
GameShop UI/wire includes receipt-related handling; this inventory does not prove production gateway ACK delivery or service success.

Market/auction/territory absence here is bounded to the fixed Native player's registered controls and the inspected Native command enum; it says nothing about unrelated server or admin-only capability.

denominatorRecommendation.reason: Freeze only after defining action-sized rows under each F01-F11 domain and marking registered UI control, action contract, authoritative response/ACK, and cross-platform comparison separately. The Native surface includes many sub-actions currently collapsed into broad domains; a source inventory does not define the complete Crystal player's behavior denominator.
denominatorRecommendation.candidateGranularity: One row per player-visible action/result contract, with repeated controls grouped only when they share the same wire and authority semantics (for example, eight guild permission-bit toggles may be a parameterized action family).
keepUnknown: Production server support/ACK for each Native request, especially guild-rank maintenance and ordinary Gold purchase.
Whether any admin/service-only market or territory capability should be considered ordinary-player functionality.
